projects.title: Financial Reporting Automation (Python → Power BI)
projects.blurb: End-to-end pipeline using Python (pandas) to clean GL extracts, build KPI tables, and publish to a Power BI semantic model with refresh-ready CSVs.
projects.outcome: Faster monthly close with transparent, auditable KPI creation.

projects.title: Budget Forecasting Dashboard
projects.blurb: Driver-based forecast with scenario toggles (Baseline/Stretch/Conservative), rolling 12-mo view, and variance analysis—ready for exec reviews.
projects.outcome: Stakeholders can self-serve forecast scenarios and explain variances.

projects.title: Q2C Process Transformation
projects.blurb: Partner-to-Cash flow: deal registration, CPQ approvals, localized invoicing, and KPI governance. Includes RACI, critical paths, and risk controls.
projects.outcome: Fewer manual handoffs, faster velocity, clearer ownership.

projects.title: Databricks OKR Engine (Finance PMO)
projects.blurb: Lightweight OKR store with SQL views, exec rollups, and ambiguity-proof joins; focuses on owner clarity and unambiguous metrics.
projects.outcome: Consistent reporting and faster decision cycles.

projects.title: YouTube → Transcript → Summary (Automation)
projects.blurb: Pipeline to ingest educational videos, generate transcripts, and summarize by speaker/topic with a future AI indexing layer.
